reason: Clearing dust from the array seems like a useful first step toward restoring power for essential services.
expectation: The soft brush will clean the solar array and improve its output now that sunlight is returning.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems relevant, but I want to address the power supply first.

effect: The array has a restored solar supply, making it possible to reconnect the discovery case.
reaction: It is reassuring to have power back, though the result gives little detail about the cleaning.
reason: The core needs continuous refrigeration, so reconnecting its case to the restored supply seems useful.
expectation: I expect the case's refrigerator to run from solar power again, though the result may involve a power changeover.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also supports essential services, but the frozen core needs dependable cooling.

effect: The discovery case is now on station power, so I can turn to the other services.
reaction: The changeover is reassuring, though the result gives no further detail.
reason: The drained water line needs to be brought back into service, and drinking water is the available compatible input.
expectation: I expect the line to be refilled or prepared to supply water again, though I am unsure whether it needs further checks first.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce toward sunlight also seems useful, but restoring the water line fits the current goal.

effect: The line is primed and water reaches the tap again, completing the services goal and revealing the goal to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: The explanation of the pump pushing air out makes the restart clearer.
reason: The lettuce trough needs to return to the window, so placing it on the growing shelf directly advances the new goal.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed at the window; the potato trough will still need to be moved.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go to the window, and either seems reasonable to move first.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only available combination and directly advances the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed at the window and the goal to be completed.

effect: The potato trough reached the window, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: The placement went as expected and felt like a straightforward close to the recovery.

mostWorthwhile.text: Priming the water line was most worthwhile: the explanation that the pump pushes air out made the restart understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was repetitive; each placement had a predictable result with little added detail.

surprise.text: The water-line result clarified how the drained line returned to service, though it was not a major surprise.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. Combining drinking water with the drained line was initially less clear, but the result explained the priming.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what happens to the discovery, though this chapter's mostly predictable recovery steps were less compelling than that unresolved story.
